### What Do We Do with Our Imperfect Worship?
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/what-do-we-do-with-our-imperfect-worship/
Passage: Leviticus 5:15
Points:
- Unintentional mishandling of holy things still incurred real guilt before God and required an unblemished sacrifice plus restitution.
- Treating sacred things carelessly defrauds God of the reverence due to Him, warning believers against halfhearted, distracted worship.
- Believers should approach gatherings with deliberate preparation, active engagement in worship, focused attention on God's Word, and ongoing reflection.
- Jesus lived in flawless obedience and offered Himself as the true, ultimate guilt offering for our sinful failures.
- Christians stand accepted and cleansed before God solely through the imputed righteousness and perfect worship of Christ.
